info.title: Briefcases.Cli
info.description: Command-line briefcase manager for Crésus Briefcases: zero-knowledge, event-sourced document storage with post-quantum cryptography

commands.name: provision
commands.description: Generate a keyset, store it locally, publish it to auth, and print the recovery phrase

options.name: --login
options.description: The auth login identifier (not necessarily an e-mail address); prompted when omitted

options.name: --auth-pwd
options.description: The auth account password; prompted (hidden) when omitted

options.name: --totp
options.description: The TOTP code for the MFA step-up; prompted when omitted (an invalid supplied code fails instead of re-prompting)

options.name: --at-rest-pwd
options.description: The at-rest password encrypting the local private keys (distinct from the auth password); falls back to the configured password, then to a hidden prompt

options.name: --reprovision
options.description: Publish a NEW keyset even when one exists, superseding it on auth (use when the recovery phrase is lost; irreversible) [default: False]
